title: Hosted product-layer changes degraded Claude Code reasoning for six weeks (Mar-Apr 2026)
summary: Three separate product-layer modifications (default reasoning effort, context/thinking retention, reduced system prompt verbosity) degraded Claude Code output quality between March and April 2026 before the provider published a postmortem on April 23. Confirms harness/system-prompt-layer regressions occur without any user-side change.

evidence.summary: Documented six-week product-layer regression with provider postmortem 2026-04-23.
